descriptionChirho: Adverbial or prepositional use indicating spatial surrounding or encirclement, including all pronominal suffixes and conjunctive/prepositional prefixes (מִן 'from around,' waw-conjunctive 'and around,' בְּ 'in the area around'), corresponding to Arabic حَوْلَ, Korean 둘레에/주변에/사방, Swahili kuzunguka/pande zote.

Substantival use denoting the surrounding area, neighboring places, or the people who are around someone, often with the article or in construct chains, corresponding to Arabic مَنْ/مَا حَوْلَ (who/what is around) or المُحِيط (the surrounding), Korean 주변들/주위 (surroundings), Swahili jirani (neighbors) or wanaomzunguka (those who surround).

The circular course or orbit of something, emphasizing cyclical motion or revolution rather than static surrounding, corresponding to Arabic دَوَرَانِ (revolution/rotation), Korean 순환들 (cycles/circuits), Swahili mizunguko (circuits/rounds).
